Bill.BriefDescription: Imposing impact fees on manufactured housing communities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to imposing impact fees on manufactured housingcommunities; and adding a new section to chapter 82.02 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.02 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Manufactured housing communities, as defined in RCW 59.20.030, areattached, multifamily housing units for the purpose of imposing impactfees under this chapter.
